main.description: Change a space: its name in the group's index, and its access record, replaced whole. Requires space.configure.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

name.description: What the group calls it, kept in its index entry.

access.description: The access record the space has now. Omitted means unchanged.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: The group has no such space, or, to name it, none in its index.

errors.name: UnknownRole
errors.description: A grant names a role that doesn't exist.

errors.name: InvalidScope
errors.description: A grant isn't a space scope.
